Chhath Puja Documentary: The Four Days of Tradition
In This Documentary, We Cover The Four Main Days Of Chhath Puja— Nahay Khay, Kharna, Sandhya Arghya, And Usha Arghya. Discover The Traditional Rituals And The Significance Of This Sacred Festival.
Is dokyumentri men hamne chhath puja ke char mukhy dinon—nahay khay, kharna, sandhyakalin arghy, aur usha kalin arghy—ko vistar se kavar kiya hai. janen is pavan parv ki paranpraen, anushthan aur lok jivan se juri kahaniyan.
